verdict.rationale: Evidence only briefly notes that Copilot can 'securely interact ... using web data and work data (Microsoft Graph and Work IQ)' as part of Microsoft 365 Copilot overview, with no Teams-specific detail on AI-generated meeting summaries, chat insights, or suggestions inside Teams itself. Missing for 10: dedicated Teams Copilot feature docs (meeting recap, chat summarization, smart suggestions), independent/hands-on confirmation of these insights working, and detail on how AI-native users access/trigger them within Teams.
